cues.en: Presenter: Now I'm going to tell you about box-and-whisker plots, which are sometimes just abbreviated to box plots.
cues.zh: 現在介紹盒鬚圖，有時簡稱盒形圖。

cues.en: So here, you see an example of a box-and-whiskers plot.
cues.zh: 這裡是盒鬚圖的例子。

cues.en: And the way you interpret this is this is showing you the distribution of a collection of data, of a dataset.
cues.zh: 它的解讀方式，是顯示一組資料、某個資料集的分布。

cues.en: So imagine this is one group, and on the Y axis here is, I'm not showing any Y axis, but imagine this Y axis shows some alchem measure,
cues.zh: 想像這是一個群體，y軸雖然沒畫出來，但假設代表某種結果測量，

cues.en: like maybe this is height.
cues.zh: 例如身高。

cues.en: So we could have height here from tall people up here, down to shorter people down here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以是身高，上面是高個子，下面是矮個子。

cues.en: So now what I'm going to do is walk you through what these different demarcations indicate on a box plot.
cues.zh: 接著逐一說明，盒形圖上這些不同標記代表什麼。

cues.en: So let's start with this line in the middle that goes through, it's not necessarily in exactly the middle of the box here, but it's gonna be somewhere towards the middle.
cues.zh: 先從穿過中間的這條線開始，它不一定剛好在盒子正中央，但會在靠近中間某處。

cues.en: That is the median of the data.
cues.zh: 那是資料的中位數。

cues.en: The median is a characteristic of a dataset.
cues.zh: 中位數是資料集的一個特徵。

cues.en: It is a measure of central tendency.
cues.zh: 是集中趨勢的量。

cues.en: I will talk more in the next section about how exactly to compute the median, but essentially it's just indicating the middle point of the data.
cues.zh: 下一節會詳細介紹中位數怎麼計算，但基本上只是表示資料的中間點。

cues.en: So 50% of the data are below the median, and 50% of the data are above the median.
cues.zh: 50%的資料低於中位數，50%高於中位數。

cues.en: And the fact that this area is smaller and this area is larger tells you that there's more data packed into this area.
cues.zh: 這塊區域比較小，這塊比較大，告訴你這裡擠進較多資料。

cues.en: So there's relatively more kind of short people compared to longer people here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡相較高個子，矮個子相對較集中。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the median.
cues.zh: 這就是中位數。

cues.en: This basically cuts the dataset in half.
cues.zh: 基本上把資料集切成兩半。

cues.en: And then we have what's called quartile one or the first quartile.
cues.zh: 接著是所謂第一四分位數。

cues.en: This is similar to the median actually, but instead of showing 50% of the data, that first quartile shows 25% of the data.
cues.zh: 其實和中位數相似，但不是50%，第一四分位數顯示的是25%的資料。

cues.en: So this means that 25% of the dataset is below this box here.
cues.zh: 意思是，資料集中有25%低於盒子的這個位置。

cues.en: So represented somewhere here.
cues.zh: 也就是在這裡某處。

cues.en: The heights below here correspond to a one quarter of the dataset.
cues.zh: 低於這裡的身高，對應四分之一的資料集。

cues.en: So I bet you can guess what this line up here is called.
cues.zh: 我猜你能猜出，上面這條線叫什麼。

cues.en: You got it.
cues.zh: 答對了。

cues.en: It's quartile three.
cues.zh: 第三四分位數。

cues.en: This would be quartile two.
cues.zh: 這裡則是第二四分位數。

cues.en: So 75% of the data are below this line.
cues.zh: 75%的資料低於這條線。

cues.en: So that also means that 25% of the data are higher than this line.
cues.zh: 所以也代表，25%的資料高於這條線。

cues.en: So in this distribution of heights, at 25% of the people are taller than whatever this particular value is.
cues.zh: 在這個身高分布中，25%的人，比這個特定值更高。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And so that also means that this box here shows us where 50% of the data are.
cues.zh: 這也代表，這個盒子顯示50%的資料所在位置。

cues.en: So half of the dataset lies between quartile one and quartile three.
cues.zh: 一半資料介於第一與第三四分位數。

cues.en: So this is 50% of the dataset in here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡有50%的資料集。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then we get to the data minimum, and I put the minimum in quotes here.
cues.zh: 接著是資料的「最小值」，我在最小值加了引號。

cues.en: So that would be this horizontal line here indicating the data minimum.
cues.zh: 這條水平線表示資料的最小值。

cues.en: Here is the data maximum.
cues.zh: 這裡是資料的最大值。

cues.en: And the reason why I put these words maximum and minimum in quotes is that these are kind of like the reasonable minimum and maximum.
cues.zh: 最大值與最小值加引號，是因為它們比較像合理的最小值、最大值。

cues.en: It's possible to have data points that are beyond the minimum and maximum.
cues.zh: 資料點可能超出這裡的最小值與最大值。

cues.en: So above this horizontal line or below this horizontal line.
cues.zh: 也就是高於這條水平線，或低於這條水平線。

cues.en: These stars here, these indicate outliers.
cues.zh: 這些星號表示離群值。

cues.en: An outlier is an unusually large value.
cues.zh: 離群值是不尋常的大數值。

cues.en: So it's a data value that is further away from the distribution that you would generally expect given where most of the data are located.
cues.zh: 也就是根據大部分資料的位置，一般預期的分布之外，距離更遠的資料值。

cues.en: So these are all the different markings of a box-and-whiskers plot.
cues.zh: 這就是盒鬚圖的各種標記。

cues.en: Now, sometimes you will see box-and-whiskers plots or box plots show even more information.
cues.zh: 有時盒鬚圖、盒形圖，還會顯示更多資訊。

cues.en: For example, sometimes box plots also show the mean.
cues.zh: 例如，有時也顯示平均值。

cues.en: The mean is a different measure of central tendency.
cues.zh: 平均值是另一種集中趨勢的量。

cues.en: And in this plot, the mean might be somewhere around here.
cues.zh: 這張圖裡，平均值可能大約在這裡。

cues.en: It gets a bit pulled up by these outliers.
cues.zh: 它被這些離群值稍微往上拉。

cues.en: But this is the basic architecture, the basic anatomy of a box plot.
cues.zh: 這就是盒形圖的基本架構、基本構造。

cues.en: So box plots are useful for a number of reasons.
cues.zh: 盒形圖有幾個用途。

cues.en: They give you a sense of the distribution of the data.
cues.zh: 能讓你了解資料的分布。

cues.en: They help you identify outliers.
cues.zh: 協助辨識離群值。

cues.en: So in fact a whole section of this course just on identifying and working with outliers.
cues.zh: 課程其實有一整節，專門介紹辨識與處理離群值。

cues.en: So we'll deal with how to quantify these in the future.
cues.zh: 之後會談如何量化。

cues.en: And box plots are also pretty interesting to look at comparing different conditions.
cues.zh: 盒形圖也很適合用來比較不同條件。

cues.en: So let's say we have, if this were heights on the Y axis, maybe these are two different groups of people.
cues.zh: 假設y軸是身高，也許這是兩群不同的人。

cues.en: So we have, you know, the blue people and the green people.
cues.zh: 有藍色群體與綠色群體。

cues.en: And what you see from these box plots is that the blue people have more variability in heights.
cues.zh: 盒形圖告訴我們，藍色群體的身高變異較大。

cues.en: So there's shorter people, but there's also a range of taller people for the blue people compared to the green people.
cues.zh: 相較綠色群體，藍色群體有比較矮的人，也有一段比較高的身高範圍。

cues.en: And there's one really, really short, unusually short green person.
cues.zh: 綠色群體中，有一位非常非常矮、異常矮的人。

cues.en: I hope he doesn't get made fun of too much in school.
cues.zh: 希望他在學校不會被嘲笑得太厲害。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: In this video, I told you about box-and-whisker plots, which are also sometimes called box plots.
cues.zh: 這部影片介紹盒鬚圖，有時也叫盒形圖。

cues.en: And I showed you the different markings on a box plot.
cues.zh: 並展示盒形圖上的不同標記。

cues.en: Again, if some of these terms were new to you, like quartiles and medians and means, you'll learn about these concepts later.
cues.zh: 如果四分位數、中位數與平均值等是新術語，稍後會學到這些概念。

cues.en: You can always come back to this video.
cues.zh: 隨時可以回來看這部影片。

cues.en: The main point to know about box plots is that they nicely illustrate both the overall distribution of the data and possible outliers,
cues.zh: 盒形圖最重要的概念，是能清楚展示整體資料分布，以及可能的離群值，

cues.en: or unusually large or unusually small data points.
cues.zh: 也就是異常大或異常小的資料點。
